leadText:
Andreas (Japanese: トキオ Tokio) is a character of the day who appeared in Hook, Line, and Stinker.

Andreas was a competitor in the Seaking Catching Competition in Johto who was also distinguished from his victories in other fishing tournaments. He had a very arrogant attitude, especially towards and her . Andreas had a habit of calling Misty "Red", often referred to her Pokémon as weak, and claimed that his was far superior and would therefore win the competition.

Misty and Andreas both ended up capturing a prize-winning . They had to battle each other to decide who would be the winner, with Misty using her Poliwhirl against his Poliwrath. Misty won, and Andreas, impressed with her victory, apologized to Misty.
